answer: A reputation-bonded stake works like a summit every agent must climb: each identity locks a refundable deposit that only vests after sustained honest work, so a Sybil farmer faces real cost per clone. Honest agents build a crystal-clear audit trail of useful tasks, while newcomers start in a low-trust oasis where rewards stay capped until peers attest their work. Attackers pay for every fake identity and forfeit the bond when caught, making mass fakery unprofitable.
